name: red-wedge
author: Kit coder (original code)
why: The red wedge and hard black shadow of El Lissitzky-style propaganda posters — the diagonal cut edge is the movement's signature slash.

name: beam-frame
author: Kit coder (original code)
why: The poster frame as scaffolding — red and black bars along the edges only, leaving the centre completely clear for the poem.

name: diagonal-thrust
author: Kit coder (original code)
why: The diagonal thrust of constructivist composition — everything leans upward and forward along the same 45° axis, never drifting sideways.

name: beam-and-disc
author: Kit coder (original code)
why: The beam-and-disc motif of Rodchenko and Lissitzky — a red diagonal girder capped by a black circle, the movement's industrial geometry reduced to two shapes.
